ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominant low-intensity (dark) pixel field across the fluke surface with approximately 10-15% coverage of high-intensity (white) pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-frequency white stippling and small-scale mottling distributed across both lobes on a dark ground; no large, contiguous white geometric blobs are present.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated boundary along the trailing edge; right lobe (image-right) exhibits more pronounced, regular peaks and valleys; left lobe (image-left) displays more irregular, lower-amplitude serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curve following a smooth trajectory from the median notch to the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of small, circular high-contrast white pixels (1-4 pixel diameter) scattered across the ventral surface, particularly concentrated on the medial and distal regions of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinctively jagged and irregular distal tip on the left lobe; right lobe distal tip ends in a sharp, singular terminal point.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy stippling/speckling pattern throughout the visible ventral area.
